KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

2. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

3. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.

4. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

5. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

9. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

10. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
